items.title: Equinix Shares Rise 2% After Launch of AI Inference Program With Nvidia and Together AI
items.summary: Equinix (NASDAQ:EQIX) shares rose 2% on Wednesday after the company announced Equinix Inference Exchange, a distributed artificial intelligence inference program developed in collaboration with Nvidia and Together AI. The program brings together Nvidia Enterprise Reference Architectures, Together AI’s inference platform and Equinix’s global infrastructure for enterprises deploying AI workloads.
